prompt: What outcome am I trying to force right now? What is one useful thing I can do without forcing the whole result?
What is the smallest honest step available before I know everything?
Where could softness make this conversation more truthful or more effective than winning would?
What can I make easier for other people without making myself the center of the work?
What would ‘enough’ look like here if I stopped borrowing someone else’s measure?
What part of my attention has wandered too far from the thing that actually sustains me?
What space, pause, or unclaimed margin would make the work more useful?
What can I repair without turning the repair into a performance or a demand for praise?
